text_en: Paul an apostle—sent neither by human commission nor from human authorities, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
text_cn: 我保禄宗徒──我蒙召为宗徒，并非由于人，也并非藉着人，而是由于耶稣基督和使他由死者中复活的天主父 ──

text_en: and all the members of God’s family who are with me, To the churches of Galatia:
text_cn: 我和同我在一起的众弟兄，致书给迦拉达众教会：

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安由天主我们的父及主耶稣基督赐与你们！

text_en: who gave himself for our sins to set us free from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
text_cn: 这基督按照天主我们父的旨意，为我们的罪恶舍弃了自己，为救我们脱离此邪恶的世代。

text_en: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 愿光荣归于天主，至于无穷之世！阿们。

text_en: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you in the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
text_cn: 我真奇怪，你们竟这样快离开了那以基督的恩宠召叫你们的天主，而归向了另一福音；

text_en: not that there is another gospel, but there are some who are confusing you and want to pervert the gospel of Christ.
text_cn: 其实，并没有别的福音，只是有一些人扰乱你们，企图改变基督的福音而已。

text_en: But even if we or an angel from heaven should proclaim to you a gospel contrary to what we proclaimed to you, let that one be accursed!
text_cn: 但是，无论谁，即使是我们，或是从天上降下的一位天使，若给你们宣讲的福音，与我们给你们所宣讲的福音不同，当受诅咒。

text_en: As we have said before, so now I repeat, if anyone proclaims to you a gospel contrary to what you received, let that one be accursed!
text_cn: 我们以前说过，如今我再说：谁若给你们宣讲福音与你们所接受的不同，当受诅咒。

text_en: Am I now seeking human approval, or God’s approval? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still pleasing people, I would not be a servant of Christ.
text_cn: 那么，我如今是讨人的喜爱，或是讨天主的喜爱呢？难道我是寻求人的欢心吗？如果我还求人的欢心，我就不是基督的仆役。

text_en: For I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel that was proclaimed by me is not of human origin;
text_cn: 弟兄们，我告诉你们；我所宣讲的福音，并不是由人而来的，

text_en: for I did not receive it from a human source, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为，我不是由人得来的，也不是由人学来的，而是由耶稣基督的启示得来的。

text_en: You have heard, no doubt, of my earlier life in Judaism. I was violently persecuting the church of God and was trying to destroy it.
text_cn: 你们一定听说过，我从前尚在犹太教中的行动：我怎样激烈地迫害过天主的教会，竭力想把她消灭；

text_en: I advanced in Judaism beyond many among my people of the same age, for I was far more zealous for the traditions of my ancestors.
text_cn: 我在犹太教中比我本族许多同年的人更为急进，对我祖先的传授更富于热忱。

text_en: But when God, who had set me apart before I was born and called me through his grace, was pleased
text_cn: 但是，从母胎中已选拔我，以恩宠召叫我的天主，却决意

text_en: to reveal his Son to me, so that I might proclaim him among the Gentiles, I did not confer with any human being,
text_cn: 将他的圣子启示给我，叫我在异民中传扬他。我当时没有与任何人商量，

text_en: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were already apostles before me, but I went away at once into Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
text_cn: 也没有上耶路撒冷去见那些在我以前作宗徒的人，我立即去了阿剌伯，然后又回到了大马士革。

text_en: Then after three years I did go up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days;
text_cn: 此后，过了三年，我才上耶路撒冷去拜见刻法，在他那里逗留了十五天，

text_en: but I did not see any other apostle except James the Lord’s brother.
text_cn: 除了主的兄弟雅各伯，我没有看见别的宗徒。

text_en: In what I am writing to you, before God, I do not lie!
text_cn: 我给你们写的都是真的，我在天主前作证，我决没有说谎。

text_en: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia,
text_cn: 此后，我往叙利亚和基里基雅地域去了。

text_en: and I was still unknown by sight to the churches of Judea that are in Christ;
text_cn: 那时，犹太境内属于基督的各教会，都没有见过我的面；

text_en: they only heard it said, “The one who formerly was persecuting us is now proclaiming the faith he once tried to destroy. ”
text_cn: 只是听说过：“那曾经迫害我们的，如今却传扬他曾经想消灭的信仰了。”

text_en: And they glorified God because of me.
text_cn: 他们就为了我而光荣天主。
